verdict.rationale: Sentry's Agents Dashboards show model costs and token usage. The LLM Calls view shows individual model requests, so you can compare token usage and cost by request and model. The traces table lists total tokens, total cost and a timestamp per trace. Breaking cost or tokens down by time period, such as aggregated trends over days, is not explicitly documented. missing for 10: documented cost/token aggregation by time period, explicit per-model cost breakdown widget, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can see cost and token usage per request, model, and time period in dashboards

citations.quote: **LLM Calls** shows individual model requests. Use it to compare models, prompts, token usage, cost, and response performance without reviewing an entire conversation or trace.
View agent executions, model costs, token usage, tool calls, and recent errors in the Agents Dashboards.
The Model Cost widget shows estimated costs based on token usage and model pricing.
Below these widgets is a traces table showing trace ID, agents, root duration, errors, LLM calls, tool calls, total tokens, total cost, and timestamp.
